summary_md: **北村健太郎 ([@sysrize](https://x.com/sysrize/status/2116066180376973357))** notes the open-weight release of **Maya 2 Native**, a 2.5B TTS model expanding from English to English plus 11 Indian languages, producing 24 kHz speech with 20 stock voices and reference-voice cloning, Apache 2.0 with separately licensed codec parts ([maya-research/maya2-native](https://huggingface.co/maya-research/maya2-native)).
relevance: Small self-hostable multilingual voice model for agentic media pipelines.
